release_notes: Tachyon AIO v0.45.10 corrects the screenshot-driven color regression and promotes Owner Console into a true Owner Vault. Tachyon keeps its black/graphite surfaces, but navigation emojis/icons, brand media and real pane SVG/image content are no longer globally grayscale-filtered, restoring the intended color identity without bringing back blue panel backgrounds or gradients. In Top/Classic appearance, Owner Vault is now a substantial 252 x 52 black-and-white privileged control anchored to the true center of the header, visually distinct from ordinary Search and Shut Down utilities. In Sidebar appearance, Owner Vault moves below all normal workspace tabs and flex-fills the remaining bottom-left navigation space as a large full-width rectangle, with collapsed-sidebar support preserved. The launcher reads OWNER VAULT with PRIVILEGED CONTROL CENTER and keeps the black Tachyon visual system. Authorization, owner APIs, tasks, updater behavior, checkout behavior and runtime boundaries are unchanged. The exact final main build passed Architecture Guard, Linux Release Preflight, Windows Consumer E2E, CodeQL, Private Core CI, real Chromium E2E and the 120-task browser soak.
